about: Source fingerprints of label extracts that do not carry their own (scripts/label-fingerprints.mjs). Each entry was verified on day `v` by extracting the label again from its source — EU: the cached PDF text of the `retrieved` day; US: the openFDA record of that set ID and version date — and finding every section identical to the stored extract. validate-release.py (gate G7) uses an entry only while the extract still has that retrieval day / set ID + version date.
